name: Map pin + address
oneliner: A pin drops on a clean little map, with your address.
description: Tells locals exactly where to find you. A stylized map, a pin drop and your street address.
prompt: When the speaker mentions the location (otherwise in the last third), show a stylized map card: 900x620px, radius 32px, centered, top at y=300, drawn from simple vector street shapes on a pale {{brand.primary}}-tinted background. Do NOT screenshot Google Maps or any map provider, and do NOT label the drawn streets with real street names. A {{brand.accent}} pin drops from 120px above with a small bounce (ease-out 300ms) to the center. Under the card: the street address in {{font.body}} 700 64px, white with a shadow, and the neighborhood or city in {{font.body}} 500 64px at 80%. The address comes from the profile only; if missing, ask. Hold 3s, 200ms out. Keep it inside the safe zone (nothing in the top 220px or bottom 320px of 1080x1920).
